out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The 2024 permit was displayed but the 2026 permit was not.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Please post the 2026 permit as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' The manager cannot locate the employee health policy documents during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. The EHS provided blank documents for the PIC. The PIC filled them out during the inspection. CDI..

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. The PIC could not locate the vomit and diarrhea policy for the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. The EHS provided the PIC with the health department model policy during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Clean towels were stored in the handsink near the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. The PIC moved the towels during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was none at the three compartment sink hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Paper towels were missing from the handsink by the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC provided paper towels at the sink during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. The sign was missing from the restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. The manager ordered a new sign during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: pizza sauce, ranch dressing, meatballs and other commercial foods in the Pepsi refrigerator were not date-marked after being removed from their package.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI. VOCELLI PIZZA (Inspection Date: 03/06/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. A spray bottle of windex was stored on the food prep table where the slicer is located.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The PIC moved the bottle during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: there was no thermometer located in the Pepsi refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Please install a thermometer in the unit as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The PIC moved the wet wiping cloths to a quaternary ammonia sanitizer solution bucket during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Unfolded pizza boxes were stored on the near the front of the kitchen and by the three compartment sink area.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Please store off the floor as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation System Cleaning
violations.observation: Intake and exhaust air ducts are not being cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent contamination by dust, dirt, and other materials. Observed an accumulation of dust on the oven hood and hood filters.
violations.corrective_action: Clean intake and exhaust air ducts at regularly intervals to prevent them from becoming sources of contamination. Please have the oven hood and hood filters as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: pizza sauce on the countertop
violations.corrective_action: The CFM marked the pizza sauce with a label, indicating the 4 hour time period, for proper discard. EHS also provided the CFM with the written procedures for compliance.

violations.title: Air/Water Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The walk in cooler affixed ambient air thermometer read +10F higher than the actual ambient temperature, at 49F.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM ordered a couple of ambient air thermometers for the refrigeration unit during the inspection for compliance.
